title: ICC says no ‘political objective’ in Duterte trial

blocks.text: MANILA – The International Criminal Court (ICC) has no “political objective” in the upcoming trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte and is committed to ensuring that the proceedings are “conducted fairly,” its spokesperson said Tuesday. “Judges will ensure that the proceedings are conducted fairly and that the rights of all trial participants are respected. The Court’s role is not to pursue any political objective,” ICC Spokesperson Oriane Maillet said in a statement. “Rather, its role is to determine, through independent and impartial judicial proceedings, whether the charges have been proven according to the law.” READ: Rodrigo Duterte finally appears in person […]...
